info.name: Select Star Metadata bi collections API

params.name: order
params.description:
Specify the ordering for the results. 

 A comma separated list for ordering by multiple fields and a preceding `-` indicates reverse order. 

Note: Order is case-sensitive.

params.name: page
params.description: A page number within the paginated result set.

params.name: page_size
params.description: Number of results to return per page.

params.name: parent
params.description: Collection parent GUID to filter by. Use `parent=null` to retrieve top-level collections.

params.description: Search a collections with multiple types of params in one go
